title: Talent Acquisition & Workforce Development Officer
description: Talent Acquisition & Workforce Development Officer Vinci Construction Ja Kingston and St. Andrew Negotiable Fixed term contract Updated 22/10/2026 Human Resource Officer Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save Responsible for proactively identifying, attracting, and assessing talent across Jamaica and the Caribbean. Builds talent pipelines, maintains workforce databases, develops partnerships, conducts candidate screening, and supports future project staffing and business growth. REPORTS TO: Head-HR & Corporate Culture LOCATION: Long Lane, Stony Hill Job Purpose To identify, attract, assess, and maintain a database of high-potential professionals, tradespersons, technicians, graduates, and students across Jamaica and the Caribbean, ensuring VINCI Construction Grands Projets possesses a readily mobilizable workforce capable of supporting future project awards and business growth. The position is focused on identifying talent before vacancies exist. GENERAL To implement any activity, process or strategy that will improve the competitive advantage of the Company in consultation with and the approval of the Country Manager. To ensure the maintenance of the good name and reputation of VINCI Construction Grands Projets, through the demonstration and practises of the highest standards of ethical conduct. To comply with the Company´s policies (disciplinary, etc ...) Responsibilities Talent Mapping Build and maintain a database of qualified candidates Develop relationships/partner with universities, technical schools, and professional institutions Identify qualified professionals across Jamaica and CARICOM countries based on typical job positions on our projects Maintain a live map of available talent by discipline Track professionals currently working for: Contractors Consultants Utilities Mining companies Manufacturing companies Public sector organizations Continuously update market intelligence regarding: Salaries Availability Experience Mobility Candidate Screening and Qualification Interview candidates even when no vacancy exists. Evaluate: Technical competence Experience Leadership potential Excellent communication skills Adaptability Health & Safety culture Mobility readiness Adequation with VINCI’s corporate culture and values Any other duties assigned by the Company which are relative to your job function. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration or related field 2-4 years full-cycle recruiting Experience with Applicant Tracking & hiring tools Proven experience in candidate sourcing Skills Excellent relationship building & communications skills Planning, organizing, and project coordination skills Problem-solving and decision-making skills Confidentiality and professional integrity Ref: Branch_10_26 Apply Now
